title: Crewed aircraft along the line
hazard: Line patrol helicopters and crop sprayers at low level inside the corridor
controls: Traffic receiver on every aircraft; notice filed 24 hours before each flight; call to the line patrol desk before launch

title: Loss of the control link
hazard: Loss of the control link beyond visual range
consequence: Fly-away or an uncontrolled landing outside the corridor
controls: Lost-link return programmed and checked before each flight; second control link on cellular

title: Birds nesting on towers
hazard: Raptors nesting on transmission towers in spring
consequence: Bird strike and loss of the aircraft inside the corridor
controls: Nest map from the line owner; 50 m stand-off from known nests March to July

title: Pilot fatigue in the operations room
hazard: Long screen time and night call-outs in the remote operations room
consequence: Missed traffic alert or slow reaction to a lost link
controls: Duty limits in the operations manual

title: Loose antenna connectors
hazard: Control antenna connectors found loose after a lost link
controls: Connector check added to the preflight checklist
